overall: The AG found the committee violated the OML by failing to announce at the June 17 meeting that it was being recorded, but found no violation on the complaint about its late response to the first complaint, given an extension.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the chair did not announce at the start of the June 17 meeting that the meeting was being recorded.
allegations.key_passage: For the reasons explained above, we find that Committee violated the Open Meeting Law when the Chair failed to announce at the beginning of the Committee's June 17 meeting that the meeting was being recorded.

allegations.summary: Second complaint alleged the committee did not meet to review or respond to the first complaint within 14 business days of receipt.
allegations.key_passage: Because the Committee had been granted an extension of time until July 22 to respond to the first complaint, we find no violation with respect to the allegation that as of July 19 the Committee had not yet responded to the first complaint.

remedy: Immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law.
remedy_passage: We order the Committee's immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law.
